security_concerns.issue: Runtime preflight validates the resolved Python target and pyvenv.cfg, but never validates runtime/bin, the lexical parent of the path actually executed. A trusted target reached through a symlink inside a writable bin directory passes validation; another user can replace that alias before root executes it.
security_concerns.reproduction: Corrected synthetic-root fixtures with a real symlink and real 0777 bin directory: validate_runtime returned successfully, and installer reached the no-launch subprocess double with the replaceable alias. Protected-tree positive control passed. No privileged or malicious process was launched; this does not assert the installed directory is currently writable.
security_concerns.minimal_fix: Before resolving the executable alias, validate PROVISIONER_PYTHON.parent and its complete lexical ancestor chain in both installer and renewal runtime checks. Continue validating the resolved target. Add a negative regression for a trusted binary reached through a writable lexical bin directory.

logic_errors.issue: HTTP 200 responses with empty bodies, null, arrays, booleans, numbers, or strings become ordinary successful MCP tool results. Only payload dictionaries containing error receive isError=true, so malformed API responses are incorrectly acknowledged as tool success.
logic_errors.reproduction: Six no-network get_stats RPC probes supplied empty, null, [], true, 17 and a string via a synthetic HTTP connection. Every reply omitted isError and returned the invalid payload as successful content. A valid object positive control passed.
logic_errors.minimal_fix: Reject empty and non-object API payloads with a fixed sanitized error before returning them from call/api. Preserve isError=true through serve; add the six response-shape regressions.

logic_errors.issue: Per-profile failure isolation remains incomplete: decode_exp accepts arbitrarily large positive integers, and skipped-token timestamp formatting is outside the profile error boundary. One malformed user-controlled profile token can abort the whole fleet renewal before later profiles or the state receipt are processed. This is inherited retained-path behavior, not a newly introduced regression.
logic_errors.reproduction: An invented shape-valid token with exp=10**100 passed decode_exp; main raised OverflowError at time.gmtime(current_exp), never reaching the second synthetic profile. Provisioner, model and network calls were replaced by doubles.
logic_errors.minimal_fix: Reject out-of-range/unrepresentable expiry values and keep profile token loading, decoding and timestamp formatting inside a per-profile exception boundary. Treat only that profile as invalid/due or failed and continue to the remaining identities.

suggestions.issue: The installer accepts and backs up an arbitrary existing root-owned roles.json, including schema=99, then overwrites it and returns complete=true. The explicit unknown-predecessor checks cover job sources and the service, not this data file.
suggestions.recommendation: Clarify whether the fail-closed predecessor policy includes inventory. If yes, allow only absent inventory, exact desired bytes, or approved predecessor hashes before writes. Otherwise document that root-staged inventory intentionally overrides unknown existing inventory. This policy ambiguity is not counted as an additional blocker.

suggestions.issue: Root-mode fixtures initially inherited unrelated 0775/0664 modes and rejected their own positive control. Both original evidence and the corrected four-case replay are retained; unaffected cases were not rerun or double-counted. The SQLite grant challenge emitted ten adapter-only parameter-binding deprecation warnings.

summary: FAIL source acceptance: three reproducible scoped blockers remain despite all 149 manifested regression cases passing. All 29 source/test hashes matched and covered the changed/new Python/JSON files. Privileged deployment remains a separate pending owner gate, not a reason for rejection. No candidate edits, commits, live model/API probes, service actions or credential actions were performed; all created evidence is under reviewer scratch.

reviewed_files.scope_note: Concurrent documentation edits were excluded from source acceptance; final source hashes remained unchanged.

fresh_challenges.interpretation: Nine failing cases reproduce three blockers; one failing assertion concerns the non-blocking existing-inventory policy ambiguity.

Non-ASCII opaque payload consumes conservative durable reservation and does not enter SQLite
Shared-only predicate enforces tenant, active/expiry, current version, membership and publisher grants on synthetic SQLite rows
